scope: S0 block0: source PSN ready -> optional forced nearest-code encoder -> integer FC1 -> fixed Q14 full-rank PSN -> integer threshold -> theta-g output
kind: finite-resource CPU service schedule, not measured RTL cycles, SRAM area, energy or PPA

coefficient_memory.port_per_bank: one read or write per service beat

persistent_Y.port: each lane has 1R1W; common forwarding handles repeated destinations
persistent_Y.empty_rows: valid bit; first FC1 contribution assigns, no fictitious add from zero

ordinary_pipeline_strengthening: Both routes start the next source frontend after the current final FC1 source read, while current PSN retains Y. If at most96 route columns are needed, the same192-column mask state is split into two buffers, so next frontend starts with current compute. This applies to all bit baselines and forced L16/L12 (90 classes); forced minpop3 needs97 columns and uses one buffer. Exact external128-byte input transactions are arbitrated against output packet beats through the256-byte input FIFO. Both row-write and column-read ports of the register mask matrix are assumed and charged as unresolved physical resources.

mask_frontend.exact_dictionary: six parallel groups of sixteen 16-bit equality comparators; fixed two-beat pipeline tail
mask_frontend.baseline: bit mask transpose; one-beat pipeline tail
mask_frontend.mask_read: one 320-bit column per beat into a four-entry descriptor FIFO; one consumer emitted per beat
mask_frontend.ordering: source order within each 16-channel group, followed by that group's code rows; no free count sorting

forced_encoder_main.argmin: one update per group per candidate
forced_encoder_main.note: captures contain projected g'; preprojection g is unavailable. Both routes of the same forced student pay fixed all-candidate search; code index is reused by LUT routing.

forced_encoder_parallel_sensitivity.note: extra combinational logic, not a same-area claim

LUT_policy: Static tables use each student's actual Wq and the train-only binary dictionary. Zero rows are implicit; singleton patterns use W. All popcount>=2 exact matches use L. A popcount>=3 policy is a sensitivity, selected without test-frame tuning.
PSN_policy: Same true Aq and thresholds within a student. Skip only source Y vectors proven zero by source-valid bits and static Aq zero entries. One 10x96 U register bank: no free overlap between positions. Shared MAC issue, completion interlocks, per-t final comparison, and 128-byte output packet are scheduled. Source PSN itself is outside both routes.
cold_fill: Pay W, resident nonzero L rows, 48-bit thresholds, Aq, zero-Y output templates, theta/context and codebook transport once. Offline formation of static L is reported separately; no input-dependent free table construction.
claims: service counts and a feasible assumed-port schedule only
source producer cost and whole-network timing remain outside scope
common raw state is explicit but foundry RF/SRAM mapping remains absent
